english.title: Producer or representative fail to become member of scheme after approval or non-approval of scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative]_

who had notified the appropriate relevant authority in accordance with regulation 14(9)(b)(i) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 of your intention to become a member of a proposed scheme which was the subject of an application for approval made under regulation 55(2) of those regulations, failed, when the proposed scheme was

(C)_[approved, to become a member of a scheme within 28 days of the date of notification given to you, as producer, under regulation 55(8)]_
(D)_[not approved, to become a member of a scheme within 28 days of the date of notification given to you under regulation 56(3)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 14(9)(b)(ii), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a producer or authorised representative who had notified authority of intention to become member of scheme
failed, when scheme was approved, to become member under reg 55(8)
OR when scheme not approved to become member under 56(3)
